newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo hires von der Heyden CFO for 1 year.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo hires von der Heyden CFO for 1 year.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc said on Wednesday that its new chief financial officer and vice chairm an Karl M. von der Heyden, 60, will stay with the company for about one year to help formulate long term growth strategy and identify a successor.
It said von der Heyden, who will also be nominated for election to the board of directors, replaces Robert Dettmer, 65, who is retiring as executive vice president and CFO.
The company said that von der Heyden has been an executive at leading consumer products companies for over 20 years, including six at PepsiCo.
